issues.where: the whole frame, air and atmosphere
issues.what: the wind-driven snow, spindrift, haze and mist curtains of -a are gone; air is clear and the sea of cloud reads as a flat lumpy floor with a clear horizon, so the storm-on-a-summit mood is lost
issues.fix: add blowing spindrift off ridges, falling snow, layered haze that fades the far spires, and a volumetric cloud sea below the ridge

issues.where: the landform: main spire and ridge
issues.what: -a is a high knife-edge ridge running down to the right with many spires stepping into cloud far below; -b is a lone cone-shaped rock sitting on a low snow mound at sea-cloud level, with no drop and no ridge line, so scale and height are lost
issues.fix: rebuild the ridge descending right with a long fall into cloud, put the spires along it receding in haze, and keep the camera high above the cloud deck

issues.what: rock is a stretched procedural texture with smeared streaks and a plastic sheen, with no faceted granite blocks, ledges or snow lodged in cracks; snow is a smooth grey-blue blanket with tiling marks and no footprints, wind crust or sastrugi
issues.fix: use faceted granite with ledges, warm rim light on edges and snow packed in cracks; give snow crisp wind texture and the footprint trail toward the cave

issues.what: a flat black hole cut into the texture with a hard edge and snow bumps in front, with no rounded arch, no depth falloff and no snow ramp leading in
issues.fix: model a rounded arch with depth and soft shading inside, and snow sloping into it

issues.where: the lightning and the far spires
issues.what: the bolt is a thin bright line that ends on a far spire with no glow on rock or cloud; in -a it strikes a spire mid-distance, lights cloud purple and throws branching sparks off the spire tip
issues.fix: add a purple cloud glow around the bolt source, a branching strike on the spire, and light spill on nearby rock

issues.what: the streamers are flat wavy ribbons with no tethers to the spire and none upper-left; in -a they are thin translucent veils tethered by lines to the peak
issues.fix: tie them to the summit with fine lines, make them translucent and lit from below, and add the far group upper-left

issues.what: the light is flat and even with too much contrast in the rock and too saturated a sunset band; -a has cold blue-violet storm light with a soft warm glow on the right faces of the rock
issues.fix: lower the contrast, cool the key light, and add warm low-sun rim light only on the right faces

issues.where: the dead animal in the foreground
issues.what: the frosted body lying on its side with legs, clawed paws and a gnarled frozen root-like mass at the head is replaced by a shapeless hairy mound in water; no limbs, claws or frost crystals, and the fur is stiff spiky cards
issues.fix: keep the creature's posture with limbs, clawed feet and the root-like mass, give it fine matted fur rimed with hoarfrost crystals, and keep the wound tones subtle

issues.where: the ground under and around the body
issues.what: -a has wet dark rock with ice glaze and frosted snow sloping up; -b has a dark rippling liquid sheet like sea water and flat snow plains with scattered pebbles
issues.fix: replace the water with glazed wet rock and icy slush, and slope the snow with crusted texture and footprints

issues.where: depth of field and the air
issues.what: -a is a shallow-focus low macro shot with a soft-focus background, blowing snow particles and haze; -b is in focus everywhere, with clear air, so it reads as a wide shot and not a close-up
issues.fix: drop the camera low, open the aperture so the spire and background soften, and add flying snow and haze

issues.where: the background landform, lightning and sky
issues.what: the background spire and cave are too large and sharp, and stand on a flat plain; the lightning is missing; the far spires stand on a sea horizon instead of above a cloud sea
issues.fix: push the spire back and soften it in haze, add the purple bolt and glow, and set the far spires above a cloud deck with the thin orange horizon

issues.what: the overcast purple-grey light with backlit frost is replaced by bright, even, contrasty light with a warm beige cast on the fur
issues.fix: cool and soften the light, and add backlight rimming the frosted fur

issues.what: -a is a frosted, faceted granite cliff with hoarfrost feathers on its edges and depth haze; -b is large flat low-poly planes with stretched, blotchy tiling textures and a blue-grey band, with no frost and no fine detail
issues.fix: use high-detail fractured granite with warm and grey tones, rime ice feathers along the left edge, and snow in the cracks

issues.what: the far spires, cloud sea, lightning and soft depth haze are missing; -b shows a flat sea horizon and a clear, dark, sharp sky
issues.fix: add the receding ridge spires above a cloud sea, the purple lightning lower right, mist, and soft defocus

issues.where: the anchors and the tethered streamers
issues.what: the clustered husks are small black blobs; the tethers are stiff wires with regular icicles; the veils are opaque grey-lilac flat cards with no iridescence, no knot and no droplets
issues.fix: make the anchors larger frosted brown husks, give the tethers sag with frost beads and water drops, and make the veils translucent and iridescent with soft light through them

issues.what: the cliff is lit flat and too brightly beige against a near-black navy sky; -a has soft, cool storm light with warm glancing light on the rock
issues.fix: darken and cool the rock, lift the sky to a stormy grey-violet, and add warm side light on the rock edges
